item.description: Prime Video has debuted the trailer for Spider-Noir, giving the first proper push to the long-gestating live-action Marvel spinoff that finally puts Nicolas Cage front and center in his first leading television role. The series premieres worldwide in spring 2026, but its rollout is a little unusual even by franchise standards: the show debuts domestically on MGM+’s linear channel before expanding globally on Prime Video in more than 240 countries and territories. item.description: SXSW finalized its 2026 Film & TV Festival lineup with 13 last-minute additions ahead of the March 12–18 run in Austin, pushing the program to 120 features (including 90 world premieres) alongside 52 short films and 20 music videos. item.title: ‘Frankenstein,’ ‘Andor,’ & ‘One Battle After Another’ Top 2026 Costume Designer Guild Awards [Complete List]
item.description: The always fashionable Costume Designers Guild picked their 2026 winners, and, as always, they found a way to spread the love. They also waited until the last award of the night not to snub legendary designer Collen Atwood. The now nine-time CDG Award and four-time Oscar winner took the Excellence in Contemporary Film honor for “One Battle After Another.” She lost two categories earlier in the night, including Excellence in Contemporary Television, which went to Kameron Lennox for “The Studio.”
